summary.text: Trenin Bayless is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Marc Lee (D).

paragraphs.text: Trenin Bayless was the Republican nominee for Montana House of Representatives District 74 in 2024, when the Democratic candidate defeated him in the general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the district on June 2, 2026.
